verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and quickly accessing one-time passwords, and says its browser extension helps you "find what you need". Its CLI can also list items by vault, which hints at vault-based grouping. There is no explicit evidence of OTP-focused search, folders or tags in the apps, or service icons for organizing many tokens. Missing for 10: documented in-app search across OTP items, folder/tag/group organization in the apps, service icons, and hands-on corroboration of managing dozens of tokens quickly.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
